Name: Puffins for Adopt 'N' Skin
Author: starmops
Description:
What this mod does

This is a sprite pack for Adopt 'N' Skin (it will not work without this mod - please check the Requirements link and the Adopt 'N' Skin instructions for full info on how to use it!). If you are tired of raising chickens or ducks, and dream about raising a puffin colony instead... this is for you!

There are 5 sprite sheets total: 2 black puffins, 2 grey puffins, and a blue puffin. The files are already named to replace chickens in Adopt 'N' Skin, but you could also use them to replace ducks (or technically dinosaurs) by changing the file names following the Adopt 'N' Skin guidelines. Just be sure to have a matching baby version.

Compatibility notes

You may need to change the numbers in the file names if they conflict with existing sprites you have.
